# Rent App

> Rent App is a demonstration apartment rental website built with Vue.js by Dawid Olko. It has one page with a project slider, an apartment filter, project cards and a section about the developer group.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rent.dawidolko.pl/): apartment listings, filters and projects

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
